evidence.quote:
Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first

observations.why: Mandating a structured onboarding checklist appeals to stability/tradition (conservation) and mastery of required capabilities (competence); the universal 'Every' frames it as an established norm.

evidence.quote:

old wiki page last quarter

observations.why: Framing the checklist as a replacement for a prior system positions it as the current stable standard, appealing to conservation of what now works.
